clue.text: Follows a daughter taking part in demonstrations

indicators.note: taking part in something means joining it from within, so these letters go inside

parts.note: demonstrations are shows, displays of how something works

explanation.surface: A daughter joins in some protest marches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Demonstrations' suggests protests, but here they are shows: A and D go inside SHOWS.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to tail them closely, a synonym for following them.

clue.text: Be suspended again the morning after

parts.note: to be suspended is to hang down from something
doing something over means doing it again

explanation.surface: A literal second spell of dangling, framed as the aftermath of a heavy night.
explanation.definitionFit: The morning after a heavy night is the common idiom for the headache and nausea that follow drinking.

clue.text: Striking a nervous response after short measure

indicators.note: the nervous response comes after the short measure, so it follows it in the answer

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of spirits such as whisky
a tic is an involuntary twitch, a nervous reaction

explanation.surface: Someone twitches noticeably after downing a small whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dramatic is striking or impressive, as in a dramatic change of scenery.

clue.text: Voodoo women desire service in court

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for women, as on toilet doors
an itch is a restless longing or desire

indicators.note: the service is placed in the court, so its letters sit inside

parts.note: the RAF (Royal Air Force) is one of the British armed services

explanation.surface: Some women want to work in a law court and dabble in voodoo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' is not a church service or tennis serve but one of Britain's armed forces, and 'in' puts it within the court's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Voodoo is a form of magic and sorcery, an example of the practice of casting spells.

clue.text: Mo has one car

parts.note: a mo is a moment, and MIN is the abbreviation for minute, another short span of time
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone called Mo owns a single vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mo' looks like a name but is short for moment, which leads to MIN (minute).
explanation.definitionFit: The Mini is a classic small British car model, so it is an example of a motor.

clue.text: Dish bound to rise — flan with no casing

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means reading from bottom to top, so the word is turned round

parts.note: a bound is a leap or jump

indicators.note: the casing is the outer letters, so only the inner letters of the word are kept

explanation.surface: A dish is certain to rise, like a flan without its pastry crust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like 'certain', but it is a jump; 'to rise' turns it upwards in this down entry, giving PAEL, and 'with no casing' strips the flan's crust.
explanation.definitionFit: Paella is a Spanish rice dish cooked with seafood or meat, an example of a dish.

clue.text: Six score, most importantly

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
a score or tally is a running count of points

explanation.surface: Getting a score of six is described as the key point.
explanation.definitionFit: Vitally means in an essential or crucial way, a synonym of most importantly.

clue.text: Try a lure, catching tons

indicators.note: catching something means holding it, so these letters go inside

parts.note: to lure is to tempt or entice

explanation.surface: An angler tries a lure and lands tons of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is a try, both meaning an effort to do something.

clue.text: Competitor following popular top-class celebrities

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
something in is fashionable or popular
the A-list is the top tier of celebrities

explanation.surface: A contestant tags along after a crowd of A-list stars.
explanation.definitionFit: A finalist is a competitor who has reached the deciding round of a contest.

clue.text: Discover nature changes hearts

indicators.note: the word nature changes into a new arrangement of its letters

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hearts, the card suit

explanation.surface: The natural world softens people's feelings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges the letters of 'nature' into UNEART; 'hearts' is the card suit, abbreviated to one letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth something is to dig it up or discover it, literally from the ground or figuratively.

clue.text: Married people must accept problem getting running water

indicators.note: to accept something is to take it in, so these letters go inside

parts.note: a race is a people, an ethnic group
ill as a noun means a trouble or problem

explanation.surface: Couples must put up with trouble to get running water connected.
explanation.definitionFit: A millrace is the channel of fast water that drives a mill wheel, so a stream of moving water.

clue.text: Most of body supporting press and TV negotiators

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits below, so it comes after

parts.note: the press and TV together are the media

indicators.note: most of a word means it loses its final letter

parts.note: the torso is the trunk of the body

explanation.surface: Most of the press and TV bodies back the negotiators.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' clips the last letter of the body's trunk to give TORS; 'supporting' means placed underneath in a down entry, so it follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Mediators are go-betweens who help two sides reach agreement, the role of negotiators.

clue.text: Fertilizer made from grass when hot

parts.note: grass and pot are both slang for cannabis
as can mean when, as in 'as he arrived'
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A garden fertilizer produced from grass cuttings in warm weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' suggests lawns but means cannabis, giving POT.
explanation.definitionFit: Potash is a potassium compound widely spread on fields as a plant fertilizer.

clue.text: Fish eat mostly plastics at first, and rubbish

parts.note: cod is a fish

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to swallow is to eat

indicators.note: at first takes just the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Fish eat a lot of plastic waste, an environmental worry.
explanation.definitionFit: Codswallop is British slang for nonsense, a synonym of rubbish in the sense of foolish talk.

clue.text: Show race vet working with no cold at all

indicators.note: working means the letters are put to work in a new order
with no tells you a piece is taken away from the mixed letters

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A vet on duty at a show race with no chill in the air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges the letters of SHOW RACE VET once 'with no cold' has removed a C.
explanation.definitionFit: Whatsoever is an emphatic way of saying at all, as in 'no doubt whatsoever'.

clue.text: Almost the last round house

definitions.meaning: a ...-final is the round before the final
a ... is a ...-detached house, sharing one wall with a neighbour

explanation.definitionFit: Short for semi-final and for semi-detached, a common British type of home.

clue.text: Coach may see risk cut straddling horse

indicators.note: straddling something means sitting either side of it, so these letters surround the horse
cut means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a chance is a risk or gamble
an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: A coach operator takes a reduced risk by riding a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the last letter of the risk word to give CHANC, and 'straddling' wraps it around a breed of horse prized for endurance.
explanation.definitionFit: A charabanc is an old-fashioned open motor coach used for day trips.

clue.text: Untroubled seeing vehicle needing energy for nothing

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
E is the symbol for energy in physics
something given for nothing is free

explanation.surface: A worry-free driver whose vehicle runs on power that costs nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Carefree means without worries, a synonym of untroubled.

clue.text: Throttle of learner driver in unusual setting

indicators.note: the learner driver goes in the other word, so its letter is placed inside

parts.note: strange means unusual
L is the learner driver's plate in Britain

explanation.surface: A learner driver struggles with the throttle in an unfamiliar car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Throttle' looks like the accelerator but is the verb, to choke.
explanation.definitionFit: To throttle someone is to choke them by the throat, a synonym of strangle.

clue.text: Class of agents protecting European Commission

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding, so these letters go round the other piece

parts.note: secret agents are spies

explanation.surface: A class of security agents guards the European Commission.
explanation.definitionFit: A species is a class or kind, as in 'a rare species of con man'.

clue.text: Presumptuous, attacking footballer

definitions.meaning: a presumptuous person is bold or overfamiliar, too pushy
a striker playing up front is called this position name

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: an overbold manner, and the striker position in a football team.

clue.text: Patch test regularly revealing performances

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: A routine skin patch test turns up results.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts are performances, such as turns in a variety show.

clue.text: Promising support with Italian debts on paper

parts.note: a prop is a support
It is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth (gin and It)
IOUs are written notes acknowledging debts

explanation.surface: A promising backer for an Italian with written debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Propitious means favourable, with good omens, a synonym of promising.

clue.text: At home, son must keep one set

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: keeping something means holding it inside, so these letters go within

parts.note: a lad is a boy or son
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: At home, a son has to keep one set aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Inlaid describes decoration set into a surface, such as wood set with mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: Some reports are pooh-poohing revolutionary works

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests turning round, so the letters are read backwards
some of the words means a run of their letters is taken

explanation.surface: Reports dismiss radical new works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks SAREPO from 'reports are pooh'; 'revolutionary' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Operas are musical dramas, and opera is Latin for works, plural of opus.

clue.text: Bullies should accept mistake, getting flowers

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so these letters go inside

parts.note: to cow is to intimidate or bully
a slip is a mistake

explanation.surface: Bullies ought to own up to an error and get some flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bullies' is a verb, giving COWS rather than male cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Cowslips are yellow wild flowers of the primrose family.

clue.text: Call for break going up summit of Everest

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means read from the bottom, so the letters are turned round

parts.note: a gap is a break

indicators.note: the summit is the top, so the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: A climber calls for a rest on the way to the top of Everest.
explanation.definitionFit: To page someone is to call them over a loudspeaker or pager.

clue.text: Mean to have nothing for a surplus

indicators.note: nothing for a means O takes the place of the letter A

parts.note: the mean is the average
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An average figure produces no surplus.
explanation.definitionFit: An overage is an excess amount, a synonym of a surplus.

clue.text: Listeners will receive call for some jewellery

indicators.note: receiving means taking in, so these letters go inside

parts.note: ears are listeners
to ring is to telephone, to call

explanation.surface: Listeners get a phone call about some jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: Earrings are items of jewellery worn on the ears, so some jewellery.

clue.text: To some extent, bewildered roadie backed bid

indicators.note: backed means read backwards
to some extent means only part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: A puzzled roadie made an offer in reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To some extent' picks DEREDRO from 'bewildered roadie'; 'backed' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Bid can mean commanded, as in 'did as he was bid', a synonym of told to do.
